segments.text: A glowing moon is shown in a dark sky, transitioning to the word "ometo" in white on a black background. The scene shifts to the top deck of a boat, where a woman with a ponytail stands still, facing the ocean and looking out at the horizon under an open sky.

A woman holds a phone and looks down at the screen. The view shifts to a man with his eyes closed, facing upward and remaining still, followed by a rear view of another man with his hair pulled back. The background remains plain and unremarkable throughout.

A calm outdoor setting by a lake with trees in the background. A woman stands near the water while a girl with a backpack is nearby. On a wooden pier, a man holds a fishing rod over the water as a woman watches him.
A woman with blonde hair blowing in the wind stands outdoors as another person walks by in the background from left to right in an open setting.

A man fishes with a rod on a calm pier as a woman stands nearby, occasionally glancing at her hair. The view transitions to cars driving on a street near a mountain, followed by a train passing on tracks with buildings in the background. A man with a bird on his shoulder stands on a street, shifting to a cyclist riding by and another person walking away with a backpack in a busy urban setting.

Two men are on a street as one pulls the other, who is wearing a backpack. A man is then seen walking on the sidewalk with an unusual lifted stride. The segment ends with a person standing in the street, the backpack still visible.

Two men stand in front of a gas station with a sign reading "we are doing here." The scene shifts to a bus driving along a road with a motion blur effect. A man carrying a backpack walks down a street as vehicles and pedestrians move in the background.

A street with visible activity: a man in a black shirt rides a bicycle past a walking person, while a woman watches from the side. A car moves in the background as another remains stationary. The scene transitions to a man lying on the ground with his head resting on a white shirt in the middle of the road.

Outdoors on a sidewalk, a man walks his bike along the street as a woman passes by in the background. Two people then walk along the sidewalk, with a camera visible behind them. A stationary bus is parked on the left, framing the urban scene.

A man runs across a bridge with a cityscape and buildings in the background. The scene shifts to two people sitting together, eating a hot chili. A close-up shows a man in a white shirt, transitioning between outdoor views and tighter shots of the individuals.

A man and a woman stand facing each other, appearing engaged. The scene transitions to a close-up profile of the man with sunlight behind him, his eyes open. He then looks away as the background blurs.

A man with a backpack stands still as the camera focuses on him. The view shifts to a woman walking away down a street, followed by a man in a black shirt standing in front of a wall. The setting alternates between outdoor movement and stationary views, with agitated speech heard but no visible speaker.

A man stands on a beach facing the ocean before transitioning to walking past a tennis court with a chain-link fence, wearing a backpack. The setting shifts to a coastal area where a man holds a microphone and raises his arm, followed by two people walking a dog along a boardwalk near the ocean, with another man seated nearby. Two men sit on benches facing the water, then the view transitions to a beachside walkway with people strolling near the shoreline. The segment concludes with two individuals walking along the beach, the ocean stretching out behind them.

A cat sits motionless on an indoor windowsill. The scene shifts to a person seated on a sidewalk, holding a dog in their lap. It concludes with a car driving along a coastal road, while several people stand on the nearby beach.

A man sits on a bench near the shoreline, facing the ocean, while a woman is seated on another bench in the background. The calm setting features the expansive ocean and no visible movement or activity from the individuals.

A car drives along a coastal road with waves and the beach visible in the background. A couple sits on a bench facing the ocean, holding hands. The scene transitions to a man seated on the bench as a woman stands nearby, followed by another man walking beside the bench. The bench and ocean remain central throughout.
Two people sit quietly on a bench overlooking a calm ocean on a sunny day, with the expansive water stretching out in the background.

A train passes by a beach, seen through a blurred window, transitioning to a sunset-lit seaside where people are visible in the distance. A car drives through a city street with smoke from its exhaust, followed by a calm scene of two people seated on a wooden bench overlooking the ocean. One person holds a phone as they sit apart, with the serene water and quiet surroundings dominating the view.

Two people sit on adjacent benches near the ocean, one holding a small dog while both watch the waves. The camera shifts to show several people seated along the shoreline, with a man in a white shirt standing on one of the benches. The setting remains calm, with the benches and expansive sea in view.

Two people sit on separate benches near the ocean, with the water stretching out in the background. The man on the right bench and the woman on the left appear to be engaged in conversation, with no other visible activity in the calm, serene setting.

An empty subway car transitions to a close-up of a woman looking at the camera against a blurred background. The scene shifts to a stationary bus interior, where two people sit together, one resting their arm on the other, as the man on the right speaks. A caption reading "one stop" is visible on the screen.

A woman in a green dress sits alone on a bench outdoors, gazing forward. The setting shifts to a train or bus, where two seated passengers are visible—one wearing headphones and the other holding a phone—while a woman in the background balances an apple on her shoulder. The scene transitions to a subway train as a woman walks through holding a phone, then to her seated in a dimly lit car, and finally to a blurred view of her driving a bus.

A train station with a woman carrying a backpack is shown briefly. The scene shifts to a man driving a car, holding an object while seated. It then transitions to a man in a white shirt with his eyes closed, remaining still.

At night near a dimly lit curbside bus stop, a parked bus with its lights on is visible as a car passes in front of it. A person stands near the bus while another walks away to the right, and a third remains near the curb. The scene transitions to a quiet city street where a man walks steadily down the sidewalk to the right, with artificial lights in the background.

At night on a dimly lit city street, a woman in a green dress is seen with her hand on her hip, holding a black purse. She begins walking along the street as parked cars line the background. The scene shifts to a man standing still in a dark, blurred setting, staring intently. It then returns to the woman, now facing the camera and holding a camera in her hand, before she resumes walking along the street.

At night, a person boards a bus with assistance from nearby children. The view shifts to a man standing beside the bus, framed by the driver inside. The scene transitions to two people standing near a stationary car in a dimly lit area, as another car passes in the background.

At night on a quiet, dimly lit street, two people walk together on a wet sidewalk in the rain. One man holds a white umbrella as they move along, with no visible vehicles or notable background activity.

At night in a dimly lit parking area, a car sits parked with its door open as a person walks away toward a street. The scene transitions to a man entering a car garage, where a woman stands in the doorway.

A black background with an image of the moon and overlaid text transitions to a woman in a simple room wearing a black top and pants. She stands with her back turned and gestures by pointing at herself.

A woman dances in the center of a living room while others interact in the background near a stationary potted plant. The scene transitions to a close-up of a jar filled with water, held by a person, revealing an animal inside. A subsequent frame focuses on a bottle of water containing a submerged mouse, with overlaid text visible on the screen.
A woman in a black tank top stands in a room with a window, holding a cat in her arms. A dog sits nearby, and the scene remains still.

An office setting shows a man standing with his hands on his hips, facing forward. The scene shifts to a woman seated at a desk, working on a laptop. It then transitions to an art studio, where a woman stands and looks directly at the camera, surrounded by art supplies.

A man plays guitar while seated in a living room with two dogs lying nearby. The setting shifts to an office where a person sits on a couch with the same two dogs. The man is then shown vacuuming a room, moving across the frame with the vacuum cleaner.

A woman in a dress sits in a room with a cat in front of her. The scene shifts to a living room where a man in shorts sits as another man stands behind him. A person is then shown holding a box with a stuffed animal, transitioning smoothly between indoor settings.

A dark room shows a man lying on his back, seemingly asleep. The scene shifts to a woman resting on a couch with her eyes closed, then to another woman lying in bed, also motionless with her eyes closed. The setting is quiet and still throughout.

A woman in a hospital room, wearing a brown top and with short hair, sits crying with her head slightly lowered, staring toward the camera. The neutral-toned walls and faintly visible medical equipment emphasize the hospital setting, while other blurred figures remain stationary in the background.

A man in a suit and tie stands indoors near a window, facing forward. The scene shifts to a woman with a tense expression, followed by a woman crying as she walks down a street with a man visible behind her. The focus remains on their movements and expressions.

Inside a car, a person is visible with a faint reflection of another in the window, followed by a close-up of a woman crying with her head in her hands, then looking down at her phone angrily. The scene shifts to a living room with an open door and a clock on the wall as a person walks across the frame. It transitions to a television screen showing a seated woman watching something, with a man visible in the background of the broadcasted image.

Two people sit on a couch in a well-lit indoor space, with a woman holding a phone as both look at its screen. The scene transitions to a static view of a wall adorned with neatly arranged framed family photos.
A woman stands in a dark setting, centered in the frame, staring directly at the camera. Her expression shifts from serious to sad as she remains mostly still, with a slight blur effect visible.

A woman walks along a pier with the ocean in the background, then transitions to carrying a backpack while walking down a city sidewalk. Two men fish on the pier, one holding a fish as the other stands nearby. The scene shifts to a woman fishing in the ocean with a man standing beside her, framed by the pier and fishing gear.

A woman walks across a bridge in an urban waterfront setting. The scene shifts to a young man with a backpack walking along a riverbank, followed by a woman standing still near the river with a bridge in the background.

A man and a woman fish on a wooden pier over open water, each holding a rod as a camera in the foreground captures the scene. The view shifts to a woman walking across a bridge with a backpack, pausing briefly to check her phone before continuing along the structure.
A man and a woman stand on a pier by a large body of water, each holding a fishing rod. The man gestures slightly while speaking as they fish together.
A woman and another person walk along the edge of a body of water with a city skyline in the background, moving closer to the camera in an open outdoor setting.

A close-up shows someone fixing a motorbike handle and brake fluid. The scene shifts to two men sitting together, playing guitars, with a camera visible behind them. It then transitions to two young men standing casually, one with his hand in his mouth.

A man and a woman stand on a boat surrounded by water as the man speaks to her. The man is later seen near a calm lake, fishing with a rod and spinning its yellow reel. On a beach, the woman in a red shirt texts on her phone before standing close to the man, both facing each other near the water.

Two people stand side by side on a beach with the ocean in the background. The camera shifts to show two men and a woman standing close together, appearing to interact. The scene transitions to a man fishing in the ocean, steadily spinning the reel of his fishing rod, with additional fishing poles visible nearby.

A woman stands outdoors holding a fishing rod and pole. The scene transitions to a young person walking through a desert with a backpack, then to a couple in a city setting talking while moving slightly left.

Two young men sit on a dock near the water, one extending his arm forward, followed by a close-up of hands interacting with a phone and a man holding a cellphone with a ship in the background. A man in a hat holds an umbrella, a person sticks out their tongue in front of a cityscape, and another man looks downward with a blurred background. A skateboarder prepares for a trick with assistance, tying shoes to a box, then performs the trick with help. The segment ends with a skateboarder riding on a street, a woman on a boat holding a fish, and a close-up of a decorative box with ornaments.

A close-up shows a hand holding a cigarette lighter, followed by a man extending his hand outward and looking upward as faint music and a farewell are heard. The scene transitions to a man near water looking at his phone, while a woman in a bikini is photographed nearby. Two people briefly interact, holding a small red object together. On a sandy beach under an open sky, a man and woman stand facing each other and move slightly. The segment ends with a close-up of a hand holding food, then someone near a beach house fence picking something off it.

A person holds a stick against a blurred background before the scene shifts to a bus interior, where a man points at the camera while seated next to a woman. It transitions to an indoor setting with a man and woman seated on a couch; the man gestures animatedly while shouting as the woman looks at him, with other men visible in the background.

Two people stand against a dark background, holding and touching hands before briefly stepping apart and turning to face each other. The scene transitions to a wet, dimly lit street at night, where two men stand close together, one holding a camera, as they move slightly in opposite directions. Reflections from the water shimmer on the ground, accompanied by faint background music.

At night in a wet outdoor setting, a couple walks steadily through the rain, their steps reflecting in the water-covered ground. The scene transitions to a man walking alone in a dimly lit park, then to another man riding a skateboard in the dark. A woman holding a gun appears briefly, followed by two people standing together and a couple exchanging glances in a city-like setting, their subtle movements framed by sparse lighting.

Two girls stand in front of a door, followed by a boy in a school hallway looking up at someone. A man with a backpack stands still in a subway station as another person moves nearby. The scene shifts to a woman in a black shirt near a man adjusting something on her, then to her holding a gun and gazing at her reflection near a red sign indoors.
A man with a backpack walks steadily to the left through an airport near a gate, with a woman visible in the background.

Indoors near a wall with blinds, a woman holding a cell phone looks into the distance. The scene shifts to a man lowering his head as he moves across the frame. In a bathroom, the man laughs before looking upward, followed by a transition to an outdoor area with a red brick wall, where an Asian man stares ahead while another person walks away from the camera.

A man is seen in a city setting through a reflection, followed by a woman staring into a mirror, wearing a large earring and jewelry. Her hair blows in the wind as on-screen text reads, "one of a kind of people." The scene shifts to the man walking through a hallway, exiting a subway station with a backpack, and continuing down a city street with urban buildings in the background.

An office building interior transitions to a woman standing outside a door with folded arms, then outdoors near the same door in a black dress and brown shirt. At night, two men stand near a building entrance as a man walks through the doorway. Two parked cars are visible under dim lighting in front of the building.
A man in a yellow shirt and a woman walk together along a calm waterfront in a city park, with the ocean and sky in the background.
A woman stands outdoors overlooking a cityscape, followed by a man gazing into the distance. Another man appears with his hands raised, concentrating on something ahead in the open area.
A man stands outdoors, looking upward in profile. The scene shifts to a man and woman standing close together, facing each other and appearing engaged, with the text "one stop" visible on the screen.

A man and a woman stand near a pier on the beach, both holding fishing poles and facing the sea. The man actively fishes while the woman stays nearby. Another man, closer to the water's edge, also holds a fishing pole against the backdrop of the shoreline and open sea.
A woman stands outdoors with her hair flowing in the wind, looking directly at the camera. The setting transitions to a beach with sand and open water, where she gazes into the distance.

A man and a woman stand on a sandy beach with the ocean in the background, facing each other and talking. They move closer, standing side by side, and share a kiss as the calm beach setting remains unchanged.

A couple fishes on a pier at sunset, with the man adjusting his stance as he holds a fishing rod and the woman standing nearby. The scene transitions to a fishing rod in the air, followed by an airplane flying through a clear blue sky with text reading "one flew." It then shows the couple standing in shallow water, both holding fishing rods as a fish is visible near them.

The segment begins with an ocean view under a cloudy sky, showing gentle waves, a boat floating on the water, and a plane flying overhead. It transitions to a city setting where a man and woman stand facing each other amidst a busy urban backdrop. The man turns toward the camera, laughing, while a stationary baseball bat is visible on the right side of the frame.

A pier overlooks the ocean as two men interact, one laughing while the other speaks. The focus shifts to a person holding a fish, followed by two people fishing with the ocean in the background. The scene transitions to a man on a boat holding a fish against the backdrop of open water.

A person stands on a wooden pier with a boat in the background. The scene shifts to someone holding a fishing rod near a river, followed by a man actively fishing, gripping the rod as he focuses on the water.

A person stands outdoors holding a glass and a white cup with a straw, then walks away with the cup. The scene shifts to a woman filling a bucket with water at a well. A man and a woman are then seen walking along a pier with the ocean in the background, transitioning to a street where they continue side by side. The segment ends at a beach with people walking near the shoreline as waves crash nearby.

A close-up shows rocks and small shells on the ground, transitioning to a beach where a person feeds a crab in the sand. The scene shifts to a river as a person feeds fish in the water and eats one. Finally, a woman in a yellow shirt stands outdoors with her hair blowing in the wind, looking downward as it moves.

A sandy beach with the sea in the background. A man and a woman face each other, talking. The view shifts to a woman in a yellow shirt speaking to another woman outdoors, followed by a close-up of a woman with long brown hair looking downward as a man stands in the background.

A man and a woman stand on a sandy beach with the sea in the background, facing each other as the man speaks and the woman listens. The scene shifts to two men standing close together on the beach, smiling and talking, with one wearing a blue shirt. The view transitions to a calm natural setting, showing water flowing among rocks and a broader perspective of the beach with no people present.

A woman in a yellow shirt stands outdoors under a clear blue sky, looking down at her phone as her hair moves slightly in the breeze. In the background, a man stands still, facing her in an open, natural setting.

Two people stand close together outdoors with a blurred background, possibly near the coast. They appear focused on a shared object, with slight shifts in position. Faint sounds of waves and wind are audible.

A rocky shoreline with gentle water flow is shown as a hand briefly touches the rocks, with text reading "one stop" overlaid. The view transitions to a beach where a person sits still on the sand, facing the crashing waves. The scene shifts to a close-up of a face, then to a sink with a cat near its water bowl, and finally to water dripping from a tap near a house door.

A man wearing a backpack and a black hat stands near a doorway indoors, talking on his cell phone. He moves slightly, revealing a room filled with people in the background, and continues speaking, saying, "Honey, I'm home, just kidding, it's just me, shoes please."

A room with light streaming through glass; a man sits at a table with a laptop. The shot shifts to two people standing close, facing each other, then to a man resting his hand on a wall in the same room.

A bedroom with a bed and lamps is shown as a man walks left across the room, followed by a woman standing nearby. They talk briefly while moving closer, and the scene shifts to two women standing in the same room. A close-up reveals a person’s face with a picture of a man on the wall behind them, transitioning to a man examining a map with a rope attached. The man then looks at a wall displaying a framed picture of himself.

In a kitchen with floral decorations and a potted plant in the background, a woman with long hair moves leftward in the foreground while a bearded man stands further back. The scene transitions to a group of two men and a woman standing close together near a table with photo frames, where one person briefly holds up a picture of a man and woman.

Indoors, a man in a suit laughs while looking up at the wall, then closes his eyes briefly before examining an object in his hands. In another room, a woman in a yellow shirt with braided hair stands in front of a mirror, her reflection visible as she looks upward and shifts slightly.

A man stands near a wall, tilts his head upward, and smiles while glancing toward a camera displayed on a TV screen. The scene transitions to a profile view of a man looking at a reflective surface, followed by a cat gazing upward with a reflection behind it, and a woman in a yellow dress looking off-screen. Finally, a man seated at a table clasps his hands to his face, smiles, and looks forward as a chair shifts slightly nearby.

A woman with red hair and a yellow shirt looks directly into the camera, remaining still against a blurred background. The scene shifts to a boy standing in front of a wall, turning his head to look behind him, followed by a man centered in the frame, staring wide-eyed at the camera.

A close-up shows hair blowing in the wind, followed by a woman smiling and holding her hair. The view shifts to a woman in a yellow shirt and white headband standing in an unclear setting, as music plays and the phrase "it's all in the lips" is heard.
A woman in a red shirt stands indoors, holding a pink pillow before switching to a Wii controller. She moves her hand expressively in the air while upbeat music plays faintly in the background.

A woman in a yellow shirt stands indoors, looking at her reflection in a mirror. The scene alternates to a man in a room with a lamp, his mouth open as if speaking or reacting. The focus shifts between the woman at the mirror and the man in the room.

A man stands in a well-lit room in front of a mirror, brushing his teeth and briefly placing one hand on his face before resuming the brushing motion. His reflection is visible, with no other notable objects or actions in the scene.

A woman smiles and looks upward, appearing to observe something in the distance. The scene shifts to a man seated in a room with a computer monitor and a lamp, remaining still. It transitions to a woman holding a camera in front of her face, seemingly taking a photo or recording.

A close-up shows a hand reaching for a plate of rice and fish with a lemon on the side, followed by a person eating with a fork. The setting shifts to a kitchen where one person stands holding a bottle while another sits at a table, eating and talking on a cell phone. The scene transitions to two people seated together at the table, eating and conversing with plates of food in view.

Indoors, a woman in a yellow dress stands by a door holding a candle before sitting down in a room with her eyes closed, visibly crying. The scene shifts to a kitchen where a man in a light blue shirt stands near a counter, facing another man as they converse with bottles visible between them.

A woman in a yellow dress sings into a microphone on stage, then appears in a yellow shirt looking down at her phone, before briefly glancing at the camera in the yellow dress again. The scene shifts to two men seated indoors at a table, one in a blue shirt and the other in a white shirt, talking with two bottles visible between them.

A dimly lit room shows a woman in a yellow shirt glancing at the camera with "one to watch" visible on screen, while a man stands still nearby. The scene shifts to a man in a blue shirt and tie speaking into a phone, saying "it's too late," against a blurred background. It returns to the woman, now in front of a lamp, staring at the camera as her expression shifts to crying, with "it's not too late" heard.

A man in a blue shirt turns his face toward the camera, briefly revealing a blurred close-up against an unclear background. The scene transitions to a woman in a yellow top holding her head in a room, her reflection visible on the wall. She appears to cry before looking directly at the camera.

A man in a blue shirt stands in a room, facing and talking to another person. A TV screen nearby displays an image of the man’s face, and a bottle sits stationary on a surface to his left. The man gestures and speaks as he interacts with the other person.

A dimly lit room with a lamp in the background. A woman in a yellow top and black pants looks at her cell phone, sings briefly, and then smiles while talking. She remains centered in the frame with subtle movements.

Indoors, a man in a blue shirt talks while looking at his cellphone near a woman. A woman in a yellow dress stands in front of a mirror, adjusting her position as she looks at her reflection. Nearby, two men interact near a computer, with one glancing at the other's shoulder; a bottle sits on a surface to the left, and a woman briefly appears in the background.

Indoors, a woman in a yellow dress stands facing the camera with a wall-mounted candle behind her, briefly glancing away as the word "really" is spoken. The scene shifts to a man holding a cup while another man watches, followed by a man checking his phone in a mirror as someone observes nearby. Finally, a man in a blue shirt looks toward a woman also dressed in blue.
Indoors, a woman in a yellow top looks at the camera with a neutral expression, briefly shifts her gaze to her reflection nearby, then returns her focus to the camera.
A man with short hair stares directly at the camera with the word "onelo" visible on screen. The scene transitions to a kitchen, where he talks to another man as the text "i'm teo" appears.

A close-up shows a woman in a yellow top as another person’s hand touches her hair. She looks ahead with an angry expression before the scene shifts to her singing into a microphone, her mouth open mid-performance.

A man holds an object in his hand, staring at it intently before looking directly at the camera. His expression shifts to anger as he turns his attention toward a nearby woman. The setting is indistinct, with no notable background details.

A woman in a yellow dress stands against a blurred background, initially closing her eyes before opening them to stare directly at the camera as the phrase "why did you leave them?" is heard. The scene transitions to a man in a blue shirt seated on a couch in a well-lit room, smiling and looking down at his phone while occasionally glancing at it.

A woman in the background smiles with her eyes closed, then transitions to crying as text appears on the screen. She is later shown in a yellow dress, looking directly into the camera against a blurred background. A man seated at a computer looks down at his phone, focused on the device. The segment ends with a woman in a yellow shirt holding a camera and standing still, facing the camera, with faint candlelight visible in the background.

A man with dark hair in a blue shirt smiles and talks while facing the camera. The scene shifts to him playing a guitar in a room with a TV visible in the background. It then cuts to a young man staring at the camera with his eyes closed, remaining still.
A man and a woman sit at a table with plates of food, beverages, and a computer near the center. A bottle is positioned between them as they eat, remaining mostly stationary.
A woman in a yellow shirt stands and looks down at a cell phone screen, appearing focused on its display. The background remains indistinct, with no other visible actions or objects.

A man in a blue shirt stands still, staring intently off-camera before the shot transitions to a close-up of his dark expression as he looks directly at the camera, saying, "You're not." The scene shifts to a woman in profile, her face partially visible, then to a close-up as she turns toward the camera. It ends with a close-up of a man's face, one eye open and the other half-closed.

A dimly lit sidewalk at night shows a man and a woman walking side by side. The scene transitions to a woman in a yellow dress standing near a black fence, followed by a man walking down a quiet street, briefly glancing toward the camera. An Indian man is then seen standing still outdoors in a dark residential area.

At night, a woman stands outside in a dimly lit area with her hand on her chest. She smokes a cigarette in a dark alley, her figure highlighted by minimal lighting. The scene transitions to her smoking on a street with a blurred, indistinct background.

At night on a dimly lit street, an Asian man in a blue shirt stands still, glancing upward. A woman walks steadily forward past a parked white car as the phrase "The ocean is calling for me" is heard. The scene transitions to a close-up of the man smiling at the camera, briefly speaking the same phrase before adding, "I'll see you tomorrow, though."
A woman stands in a graffiti-covered room, looking into a mirror and staring at her reflection. The scene shifts to a sparsely detailed room where a man hugs another man from behind.
A woman lies asleep in a dark, still room, her head resting on a pillow with no visible movement or additional objects in the frame.

A black background with the text "one" and an image of a man transitions to the film's title displayed prominently. The scene shifts to a bathroom where a person cleans the inside of a toilet bowl with a brush, water visible during the action. A bowl with white liquid sits on the floor nearby.

A woman stands in a bathroom near a toilet, holding the bowl with one hand and looking toward the camera. The scene transitions to two women sitting on a couch in a living room; one wipes her face as if crying while the other leans toward her, appearing to speak. Soft music plays faintly throughout.
A plane flies through a clear sky, followed by a view of a hilltop where a woman stands facing the camera. She smiles warmly as the open sky remains visible behind her.

A skateboarder glides along a sandy beach with the ocean stretching under a clear sky. The scene transitions to a man sitting indoors on a couch facing large windows with an ocean sunset view, followed by two people silhouetted on a beach bench against the setting sun. On the shore, a boat floats with a single occupant, while two men fish nearby—one seated on a couch on the sand—amid others with fishing rods, a parked car, and a bench in the background.

A woman stands on a bridge with a bicycle, then moves to stand in front of a car, holding her hands toward the camera, before sitting on a bench along a street and looking upward. The scene transitions to two people talking and playing on a beach at sunset, followed by two men conversing on a street, one holding a hat. Finally, two individuals are on a boat in the ocean, with one holding a camera while the other stands nearby.

A hospital room with a woman in a hospital gown seated or lying in a bed, speaking to a nurse standing nearby. The nurse interacts with her as the woman asks, "Have you seen Angelo?" amidst visible medical equipment.
Inside a car, a woman with tied-up hair sits in profile, focused on a screen in front of her. The camera briefly shifts, capturing its reflection on her head, while the setting remains static.

A woman with short brown hair and blue eyes stands in a room, looking at her reflection in a mirror. Another girl is visible in the background, positioned slightly to the right. The scene remains still, centered on the mirror and their relative positions.
Indoors, a man with long hair and a beard is visible. The shot transitions to a man in a suit and tie looking to the left, then to a close-up of him intently examining something in his hands.
A woman sits on a couch in a living room, facing a man in a red shirt. She talks to him while one of them holds a visible cell phone, with no other notable movement in the scene.

A man holds a phone to his face as a woman stands nearby watching him. The scene shifts to two women, one pointing toward the other, followed by a view of the two women talking in front of a window with closed blinds.

A man lies asleep in a hospital bed with a medical mask, surrounded by monitors and hospital equipment. The scene transitions to a close-up of a man in a suit and tie, followed by him sitting in the back seat of a moving car with "onelo" visible on the vehicle.

A man in a black jacket with a ponytail stands in a hospital hallway behind a woman. The scene shifts to an office where the woman talks on the phone at a desk. The view transitions to a video game title screen, followed by a black background with the text "one stop," and ends with a single picture centered on the screen.

A rocky ocean shoreline with a small waterfall in the background transitions to a closer view of beach rocks and water. The scene ends with a wide shot of the beach, showcasing rocks, waves, and a clear blue sky.

A storm looms over the ocean with dark clouds and churning water. The camera shifts to a person walking along a wide, empty beach, the storm visible in the distance. A kite flies overhead as they continue along the sand.
A hospital room with several people standing and one person seated transitions to a brightly lit hallway, where two men walk side by side past doors and walls typical of a medical facility.
